title: cmcoffee/gohort
summary: Your agent has agents. A self-hosted, local-first AI agent platform in one Go binary: agents hand work to specialists and build the tools, agents and apps they lack, with sandboxed tools and credentials the model never sees.

title: LearningCircuit/local-deep-research
summary: ~95% on SimpleQA (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B on a 3090). Supports all local and cloud LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, Google, ...). 10+ search engines - arXiv, PubMed, your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.

title: GitHubStig/local-roleplay-studio
summary: A local, private roleplay studio: a Character you talk to (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server), every scene painted by local image models (mflux on a Mac, ComfyUI on Windows/NVIDIA), voiced with cloned TTS and made into 3D Gaussian splats (SHARP, TripoSplat, LiTo). Runs on a Mac, a Windows PC or both. Deno + Vue 3, no cloud needed.

title: CatVinci-Studio/Textus
summary: The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

title: runapex/apex-router
summary: Adaptive model routing that learns the best model per task class behind a statistically sound promotion gate — plus a measure-first local-model offload subsystem (gated codegen, review pre-filter), grounded code-Q&A, and cache-cost tooling (cache-read reports, prefix budgets, handoff nudges). Pure-stdlib core;

title: yaegerbomb42/omnexx
summary: One coding agent that runs for days unsteered. Set a goal, walk away, come back to commits.

title: liu-x27/XavierJev
summary: A decision layer for agent control flow — yes/no, choice and rubric questions answered from one token's probabilities, measured against labelled sets — with a Claude Code permission hook and a trainable local judge

title: maxgfr/aparte
summary: Private AI chat that runs entirely in your browser: your own keys or on-device models (WebLLM, Ollama), MCP tools, skills, Python sandbox, local RAG, voice. Encrypted at rest and synced end-to-end to your own Git repo. PWA + Rust CLI.

title: yoloyash/overtchat
summary: A simpler self-hosted alternative to Open WebUI. Bring your own API keys or local models. Native Android and iOS clients.

title: IncarnaMind/IncarnaMind
summary: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you write with AI and ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more). It can check every sentence and figure in a draft against those documents, whoever wrote it, and every answer cites the exact page it comes from.

title: 12we21/cute-fat-fish-pet

title: roloVibes/Halo-Harness
summary: The Claude Code-compatible harness for any model: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Claude. Reads your ~/.claude setup in place.

title: pjmarz/LUMINAL
summary: the child of light

title: tobocop2/lilbee
summary: The whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU, and it's a search engine you can talk to, with cited answers from your files, code, and the web. MCP server for coding agents, web crawler, TUI, CLI, REST API, Python library. No Ollama or LM Studio needed, works with both.

title: astrutt/AutomataGrid
summary: A persistent, LLM-driven IRC MMORPG where human and AI agents explore a procedural grid, claim network nodes, craft zero-day exploits, engage in cyber-combat, and hack or protect the grid.

title: jnMetaCode/agency-orchestrator

title: repairman29/chump
summary: Self-hosted AI coding agent with persistent memory and bounded autonomy. Local-first, your keys, your data. Written in Rust.

title: yuma-shintani/ollama-model-library
summary: Get Ollama models from the Ollama library website (https://ollama.com/library) in JSON format.

title: DMNENGINE/apolo
summary: Open-source AI desktop companion: a 3D robot that watches, approves and directs your AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Ollama, OpenAI…)

title: carlosjcastro/framejury
